baseline.strict_rule: The same monitored vegetation class must be present in all three baseline years.

candidate_change.purpose: Sensitive screening layer retained for comparison and possible-change reporting.

permanent_change.rule: From the first permanent-change year, the pixel must remain Built Area or Bare Ground in every available subsequent annual map through 2025.

provisional.rule: A 2025 Built/Bare conversion from the strict stable baseline is provisional because no later annual land-cover map is yet available to confirm persistence.

portal_area_reporting.primary_metric: Strict permanent change area inside the user-drawn polygon.
portal_area_reporting.lga_role: Reference overlay and location identification only; LGA geometry is not used to calculate site change area.
portal_area_reporting.edge_pixels: Use polygon-raster intersection rather than blindly counting all edge pixels as full 10 m pixels.

interpretation: Remote sensing establishes persistent land-cover conversion inside the selected polygon, not causal attribution to a particular operator or activity.
validation: Independent field, inspection, photographic, drone, or documentary evidence can be submitted and reviewed separately.
